name: scp
description: Copies files or directories between hosts on a network

options.description: Copies between two remote hosts are transferred through the local host
Forces scp to use IPv4 addresses only
Forces scp to use IPv6 addresses only

name: -A
options.description: Allows forwarding of ssh-agent(1) to the remote system

name: -B
options.description: Selects batch mode (prevents asking for passwords or passphrases)

name: -C
options.description: Compression enable. Passes the -C flag to ssh(1) to enable compression

name: -c
options.description: Selects the cipher to use for encrypting the data transfer

name: -F
options.description: Specifies an alternative per-user configuration file for ssh

name: -i
options.description: Selects the file from which the identity (private key) for public key authentication is read

name: -J
options.description: Connect to the target host by first making an scp connection to the jump host described by destination and th…

name: -l
options.description: Limits the used bandwidth, specified in Kbit/s

name: -o
options.description: Can be used to pass options to ssh in the format used in ssh_config(5)

name: -P
options.description: Specifies the port to connect to on the remote host

name: -p
options.description: Preserves modification times, access times, and modes from the original file

name: -q
options.description: Quiet mode: disables the progress meter as well as warning and diagnostic messages from ssh(1)

name: -S
options.description: Name of program to use for the encrypted connection
